title.narrative: Peer-to-Peer institutional support to the Office of the Auditor General in Zambia

description.narrative: The specific objective is to improve the management and technical capacity of the Office of the Auditor General (OAG) to plan and undertake audits as prescribed by the law and in line with international standards and best practices. The support is provided through Twinning with a Consortium of public and mandated institutions from EU Member States.
